metadata.division: DIVISION 1-1-4. RELATIONSHIP TO OTHER CODES, ORDINANCES, AND REGULATIONS

content.title: 1-1-4-3. Conflict with private agreements.
content.summary: It is not the intent of this Code to interfere with, abrogate, or annul any easement, covenant, deed restriction, or other agreement between private parties. If the provisions of this Code impose a greater restriction than imposed by a private agreement, the provisions of this Code will control.

faqs.a: It is not the intent of this Code to interfere with, abrogate, or annul any easement, covenant, deed restriction, or other agreement between private parties. If the provisions of this Code impose a greater restriction than imposed by a private agreement, the provisions of this Code will control. If the provisions of a private agreement impose a greater restriction than this Code, the provisions of the private agreement will control. The City shall not be responsible for monitoring or enforcing private agreements.
